## Problem

Phase Landing hardcodes a full local "tier-2" suite as a required merge gate. That policy is opaque (tier-2 ≠ regression) and wrong for a plugin: suite cost and meaning vary by repository. Hours are wasted on full runs and flake retries that the agent cannot lawfully skip.
